blocks.text: The range is a measure of the spread or dispersion of a set of data. It is the simplest form of variability and is used to understand the extent of variation in the dataset. The range represents the difference between the maximum and minimum values in a dataset. A larger range suggests a greater spread of data, meaning the data points are more dispersed from each other while a smaller range indicates that the data points are closely clustered around a central value.
